fullText.simplified:
第十章、我被流放了

    失去杀张宜的机会后，接下来的五年里，楚国的情况没有大的变动。
    秦国与其他国家有一些战争，但对楚国的影响不大。楚怀王一会儿想着和秦国结盟，一会儿想着和齐国结盟，一直在犹豫。
    楚怀王没有给我新的工作，除了教王室子弟文化知识，我没有别的事情。也许楚怀王还是信任我的，但他不愿意把国家大事交给我了，也不愿意问我的意见了。
    第六年，情况变了，秦国换了一个年轻的王。这个新王告诉楚怀王，他的母亲是楚国人，他和母亲都希望秦国和楚国结盟。为了让楚怀王相信，他们会把一块秦国抢走的土地还给楚国。新王还希望能和楚怀王的女儿结婚，这样秦国和楚国就能一直友好。
    楚怀王十分高兴，那些一直希望与秦国结盟的贵族和官员们也十分高兴。楚国很快与秦国结盟了，两国的关系变得比任何时候都好。
    这时候，更没有人愿意听我说话了。我的声音是两国关系里最不好听的声音。但是为了楚国的明天，我还是要说。
    我对楚怀王说：“秦王在骗您，他太年轻了，秦国国内有人反对他做王。他与您结盟是想通过楚国的支持与帮助，让那些反对他的人不敢说话。他不是真心想与您结盟，您不能相信他。”
    楚怀王一个字也不想听，他生气了。他要我离开引都，去汉北流放。
    什么是流放？把做了错事、坏事的人放到很远、生活条件很差的地方去，这就是流放。我被流放了，但是我做错了什么呢？
    我伤心地离开了引都。
fullText.traditional:
第十章、我被流放了

    失去殺張宜的機會後，接下來的五年裡，楚國的情況沒有大的變動。
    秦國與其他國家有一些戰爭，但對楚國的影響不大。楚懷王一會兒想著和秦國結盟，一會兒想著和齊國結盟，一直在猶豫。
    楚懷王沒有給我新的工作，除了教王室子弟文化知識，我沒有別的事情。也許楚懷王還是信任我的，但他不願意把國家大事交給我了，也不願意問我的意見了。
    第六年，情況變了，秦國換了一個年輕的王。這個新王告訴楚懷王，他的母親是楚國人，他和母親都希望秦國和楚國結盟。為了讓楚懷王相信，他們會把一塊秦國搶走的土地還給楚國。新王還希望能和楚懷王的女兒結婚，這樣秦國和楚國就能一直友好。
    楚懷王十分高興，那些一直希望與秦國結盟的貴族和官員們也十分高興。楚國很快與秦國結盟了，兩國的關係變得比任何時候都好。
    這時候，更沒有人願意聽我說話了。我的聲音是兩國關係裡最不好聽的聲音。但是為了楚國的明天，我還是要說。
    我對楚懷王說：“秦王在騙您，他太年輕了，秦國國內有人反對他做王。他與您結盟是想通過楚國的支持與幫助，讓那些反對他的人不敢說話。他不是真心想與您結盟，您不能相信他。”
    楚懷王一個字也不想聽，他生氣了。他要我離開引都，去漢北流放。
    什麼是流放？把做了錯事、壞事的人放到很遠、生活條件很差的地方去，這就是流放。我被流放了，但是我做錯了什麼呢？
    我傷心地離開了引都。

sentences.simplified: 失去杀张宜的机会后，接下来的五年里，楚国的情况没有大的变动。
sentences.traditional: 失去殺張宜的機會後，接下來的五年裡，楚國的情況沒有大的變動。
sentences.pinyin: shī qù shā zhāng yí de jī huì hòu jiē xià lái de wǔ nián lǐ chǔ guó de qíng kuàng méi yǒu dà de biàn dòng
sentences.english: After losing the opportunity to kill Zhang Yi, there were no major changes in the state of Chu over the next five years.

sentences.simplified: 秦国与其他国家有一些战争，但对楚国的影响不大。
sentences.traditional: 秦國與其他國家有一些戰爭，但對楚國的影響不大。
sentences.pinyin: qín guó yǔ qí tā guó jiā yǒu yì xiē zhàn zhēng dàn duì chǔ guó de yǐng xiǎng bú dà
sentences.english: Qin had some wars with other states, but they had little impact on Chu.

sentences.simplified: 楚怀王一会儿想着和秦国结盟，一会儿想着和齐国结盟，一直在犹豫。
sentences.traditional: 楚懷王一會兒想著和秦國結盟，一會兒想著和齊國結盟，一直在猶豫。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ huái wáng yí huì'r xiǎng zhe hé qín guó jié méng yí huì'r xiǎng zhe hé qí guó jié méng yì zhí zài yóu yù
sentences.english: King Huai of Chu sometimes thought about allying with Qin, and other times about allying with Qi, always hesitating.

sentences.simplified: 楚怀王没有给我新的工作，除了教王室子弟文化知识，我没有别的事情。
sentences.traditional: 楚懷王沒有給我新的工作，除了教王室子弟文化知識，我沒有別的事情。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ huái wáng méi yǒu gěi wǒ xīn de gōng zuò chú le jiāo wáng shì zǐ dì wén huà zhī shi wǒ méi yǒu bié de shì qing
sentences.english: King Huai of Chu didn’t assign me any new duties. Besides teaching the royal children cultural knowledge, I had nothing else to do.

sentences.simplified: 也许楚怀王还是信任我的，但他不愿意把国家大事交给我了，也不愿意问我的意见了。
sentences.traditional: 也許楚懷王還是信任我的，但他不願意把國家大事交給我了，也不願意問我的意見了。
sentences.pinyin: yě xǔ chǔ huái wáng hái shì xìn rèn wǒ de dàn tā bú yuàn yì bǎ guó jiā dà shì jiāo gěi wǒ le yě bú yuàn yì wèn wǒ de yì jiàn le
sentences.english: Perhaps King Huai of Chu still trusted me, but he was no longer willing to entrust me with important state affairs or seek my advice.

sentences.simplified: 第六年，情况变了，秦国换了一个年轻的王。
sentences.traditional: 第六年，情況變了，秦國換了一個年輕的王。
sentences.pinyin: dì liù nián qíng kuàng biàn le qín guó huàn le yí ge nián qīng de wáng
sentences.english: In the sixth year, the situation changed. Qin got a new, young king.

sentences.simplified: 这个新王告诉楚怀王，他的母亲是楚国人，他和母亲都希望秦国和楚国结盟。
sentences.traditional: 這個新王告訴楚懷王，他的母親是楚國人，他和母親都希望秦國和楚國結盟。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge xīn wáng gào su chǔ huái wáng tā de mǔ qīn shì chǔ guó rén tā hé mǔ qīn dōu xī wàng qín guó hé chǔ guó jié méng
sentences.english: The new king told King Huai of Chu that his mother was from Chu and that both he and his mother hoped Qin and Chu would form an alliance.

sentences.simplified: 为了让楚怀王相信，他们会把一块秦国抢走的土地还给楚国。
sentences.traditional: 為了讓楚懷王相信，他們會把一塊秦國搶走的土地還給楚國。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le ràng chǔ huái wáng xiāng xìn tā men huì bǎ yí kuài qín guó qiǎng zǒu de tǔ dì huán gěi chǔ guó
sentences.english: To win King Huai of Chu’s trust, they would return a piece of land that Qin had taken from Chu.

sentences.simplified: 新王还希望能和楚怀王的女儿结婚，这样秦国和楚国就能一直友好。
sentences.traditional: 新王還希望能和楚懷王的女兒結婚，這樣秦國和楚國就能一直友好。
sentences.pinyin: xīn wáng hái xī wàng néng hé chǔ huái wáng de nǚ ér jié hūn zhè yàng qín guó hé chǔ guó jiù néng yì zhí yǒu hǎo
sentences.english: The new king also hoped to marry King Huai of Chu’s daughter so that Qin and Chu could remain friendly forever.

sentences.simplified: 楚怀王十分高兴，那些一直希望与秦国结盟的贵族和官员们也十分高兴。
sentences.traditional: 楚懷王十分高興，那些一直希望與秦國結盟的貴族和官員們也十分高興。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ huái wáng shí fēn gāo xìng nà xiē yì zhí xī wàng yǔ qín guó jié méng de guì zú hé guān yuán men yě shí fēn gāo xìng
sentences.english: King Huai of Chu was very happy, and the nobles and officials who had long hoped for an alliance with Qin were also very happy.

sentences.simplified: 楚国很快与秦国结盟了，两国的关系变得比任何时候都好。
sentences.traditional: 楚國很快與秦國結盟了，兩國的關係變得比任何時候都好。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ guó hěn kuài yǔ qín guó jié méng le liǎng guó de guān xi biàn de bǐ rèn hé shí hou dōu hǎo
sentences.english: Chu quickly formed an alliance with Qin, and the relationship between the two countries became better than ever.

sentences.simplified: 这时候，更没有人愿意听我说话了。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，更沒有人願意聽我說話了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou gèng méi yǒu rén yuàn yì tīng wǒ shuō huà le
sentences.english: At that point, no one was willing to listen to me anymore.

sentences.simplified: 我的声音是两国关系里最不好听的声音。
sentences.traditional: 我的聲音是兩國關係裡最不好聽的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de shēng yīn shì liǎng guó guān xi lǐ zuì bù hǎo tīng de shēng yīn
sentences.english: My voice was the most unwelcome one in the relationship between the two states.

sentences.simplified: 但是为了楚国的明天，我还是要说。
sentences.traditional: 但是為了楚國的明天，我還是要說。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì wèi le chǔ guó de míng tiān wǒ hái shi yào shuō
sentences.english: But for the sake of Chu’s future, I still had to speak up.

sentences.simplified: 我对楚怀王说：“秦王在骗您，他太年轻了，秦国国内有人反对他做王。
sentences.traditional: 我對楚懷王說：“秦王在騙您，他太年輕了，秦國國內有人反對他做王。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ duì chǔ huái wáng shuō qín wáng zài piàn nín tā tài nián qīng le qín guó guó nèi yǒu rén fǎn duì tā zuò wáng
sentences.english: I said to King Huai of Chu, “The King of Qin is deceiving you. He is too young, and there are people in Qin who oppose him being king.

sentences.simplified: 他与您结盟是想通过楚国的支持与帮助，让那些反对他的人不敢说话。
sentences.traditional: 他與您結盟是想通過楚國的支持與幫助，讓那些反對他的人不敢說話。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǔ nín jié méng shì xiǎng tōng guò chǔ guó de zhī chí yǔ bāng zhù ràng nà xiē fǎn duì tā de rén bù gǎn shuō huà
sentences.english: He is allying with you because he wants to use Chu’s support and help to silence those who oppose him.

sentences.simplified: 他不是真心想与您结盟，您不能相信他。”
sentences.traditional: 他不是真心想與您結盟，您不能相信他。”
sentences.pinyin: tā bú shì zhēn xīn xiǎng yǔ nín jié méng nín bù néng xiāng xìn tā
sentences.english: He does not sincerely want to ally with you, and you cannot trust him.”

sentences.simplified: 楚怀王一个字也不想听，他生气了。他要我离开引都，去汉北流放。
sentences.traditional: 楚懷王一個字也不想聽，他生氣了。他要我離開引都，去漢北流放。
sentences.pinyin: chǔ huái wáng yí ge zì yě bù xiǎng tīng tā shēng qì le tā yào wǒ lí kāi yǐn dū qù hàn běi liú fàng
sentences.english: King Huai of Chu didn’t want to hear a single word of it, and he became angry. He demanded that I leave Yindu and banished me to Hanbei.

sentences.simplified: 什么是流放？
sentences.traditional: 什麼是流放？
sentences.pinyin: shén me shì liú fàng
sentences.english: What is banishment?

sentences.simplified: 把做了错事、坏事的人放到很远、生活条件很差的地方去，这就是流放。
sentences.traditional: 把做了錯事、壞事的人放到很遠、生活條件很差的地方去，這就是流放。
sentences.pinyin: bǎ zuò le cuò shì huài shì de rén fàng dào hěn yuǎn shēng huó tiáo jiàn hěn chà de dì fang qù zhè jiù shì liú fàng
sentences.english: It is sending someone who has done something wrong or bad to a distant place with poor living conditions. This is banishment.

sentences.simplified: 我被流放了，但是我做错了什么呢？
sentences.traditional: 我被流放了，但是我做錯了什麼呢？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bèi liú fàng le dàn shì wǒ zuò cuò le shén me ne
sentences.english: I had been banished, but what had I done wrong?

sentences.simplified: 我伤心地离开了引都。
sentences.traditional: 我傷心地離開了引都。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shāng xīn de lí kāi le yǐn dū
sentences.english: I left Yindu in sadness.

sentence_translations: Chapter 10: I Am Banished
After losing the opportunity to kill Zhang Yi, there were no major changes in the state of Chu over the next five years.
Qin had some wars with other states, but they had little impact on Chu.
King Huai of Chu sometimes thought about allying with Qin, and other times about allying with Qi, always hesitating.
King Huai of Chu didn’t assign me any new duties. Besides teaching the royal children cultural knowledge, I had nothing else to do.
Perhaps King Huai of Chu still trusted me, but he was no longer willing to entrust me with important state affairs or seek my advice.
In the sixth year, the situation changed. Qin got a new, young king.
The new king told King Huai of Chu that his mother was from Chu and that both he and his mother hoped Qin and Chu would form an alliance.
To win King Huai of Chu’s trust, they would return a piece of land that Qin had taken from Chu.
The new king also hoped to marry King Huai of Chu’s daughter so that Qin and Chu could remain friendly forever.
King Huai of Chu was very happy, and the nobles and officials who had long hoped for an alliance with Qin were also very happy.
Chu quickly formed an alliance with Qin, and the relationship between the two countries became better than ever.
At that point, no one was willing to listen to me anymore.
My voice was the most unwelcome one in the relationship between the two states.
But for the sake of Chu’s future, I still had to speak up.
I said to King Huai of Chu, “The King of Qin is deceiving you. He is too young, and there are people in Qin who oppose him being king.
He is allying with you because he wants to use Chu’s support and help to silence those who oppose him.
He does not sincerely want to ally with you, and you cannot trust him.”
King Huai of Chu didn’t want to hear a single word of it, and he became angry. He demanded that I leave Yindu and banished me to Hanbei.
What is banishment?
It is sending someone who has done something wrong or bad to a distant place with poor living conditions. This is banishment.
I had been banished, but what had I done wrong?
I left Yindu in sadness.
